title: curl: new option --sync newer file in range
body:
# New Option `--sync` Proposal

This PR will hopefully check off [TODO 18.1](https://github.com/jhauga/curl/blob/ee97c2a96a07bad19504973df1384b18419a8eac/docs/TODO#L950C1-L950C5).

> 18.1 sync
> 
>  "curl --sync http://example.com/feed[1-100].rss" or
>  "curl --sync http://example.net/{index,calendar,history}.html"
> 
>  Downloads a range or set of URLs using the remote name, but only if the
>  remote file is newer than the local file. A Last-Modified HTTP date header
>  should also be used to set the mod date on the downloaded file.

This option combines three behaviors:

- `--remote-name` (save with the remote filename)
- `--remote-time` (set local modification time from Last-Modified header)
- `--time-cond` (only download if remote is newer than local file)

Equivalent to: `curl -O -R -z localfile URL`

## Example Usage:

```bash
curl --sync $URL/[1-100]
curl --sync $URL/{a,b,c}
```

## Local Testing

Tested with 100 files (`file1.txt` to `file100.txt`) on remote server:

- :white_check_mark: Range patterns: `--sync file[1-10].txt`.
- :white_check_mark: Brace patterns: `--sync {file20,file40,file80,file100}.txt`.
- :white_check_mark: Multiple `--sync` flags in single command.
- :white_check_mark: Local/remote file changes detected and synced correctly.
   - Returns `curl: (23) client returned ERROR on write of 27 bytes` if not updated.
- :white_check_mark: Works with `--output-dir`.
- :white_check_mark: Works with `--output` using `#n` placeholder.
- :white_check_mark: Missing remote files skipped.

### Test Commands

```bash
# Range patterns
src/curl --sync $URL/file[1-10].txt
# Brace patterns
src/curl --sync $URL/{file20,file40,file80,file160,file100}.txt
# Missing remote
src/curl --sync -L $URL/{file20,file40,file80,file160,file100}.txt
# Multiple
src/curl --sync $URL/file[1-10].txt --sync $URL/{file20,file40,file80,file160,file100}.txt
# With --output-dir
src/curl --sync $URL/file[1-10].txt --output-dir tmp
# With --output using #n placeholder
src/curl --sync $URL/file[1-10].txt -o name#1
# With --output-dir and --output using #n placeholder
src/curl --sync $URL/file[1-10].txt --output-dir tmp -o name#1
```

+---
+c: Copyright (C) Daniel Stenberg, <daniel@haxx.se>, et al.
+SPDX-License-Identifier: curl
+Long: sync
+Help: Sync download with remote name/time/conditional
+Category: output
+Added: 8.18.0
+Multi: boolean
+See-also:
+  - remote-name
+  - remote-time
+  - time-cond
+Example:
+  - --sync $URL/[1-100]
+  - --sync $URL/{a,b,c}
+  - --sync --output-dir "tmp" $URL/[1-100]
+---
+
+# `--sync`
+
+Download files only if they return HTTP 200 OK status and are newer than the
+local version (if it exists), using the remote filename, and set the local
+file's modification time to match the remote file's Last-Modified header.
+
+If the local file does not exist, it is downloaded (if HTTP 200 is returned).
+If it exists and the remote file is newer (based on Last-Modified header), the
+local file is updated. Otherwise, no download occurs.
+
+Files that return HTTP errors (4xx, 5xx) or redirects (3xx) are automatically
+skipped without creating local files.
+
+The file is saved in the current working directory. Use --output-dir to save
+in a different directory.

+<info>
+<keywords>
+HTTP
+HTTP GET
+--sync
+</keywords>
+</info>
+
+#
+# Server-side
+<reply>
+<data nocheck="yes">
+HTTP/1.1 200 OK
+Date: Tue, 09 Nov 2010 14:49:00 GMT
+Server: test-server/fake
+Last-Modified: Tue, 13 Jun 2000 12:10:00 GMT
+Content-Length: 6
+Content-Type: text/html
+
+-foo-
+</data>
+</reply>
+
+#
+# Client-side
+<client>
+<server>
+http
+</server>
+<name>
+HTTP GET with --sync (downloads with remote name)
+</name>
+<command option="no-include">
+--sync --output-dir %LOGDIR http://%HOSTIP:%HTTPPORT/%TESTNUMBER
+</command>
+</client>
+
+#
+# Verify data after the test has been "shot"
+<verify>
+<protocol crlf="headers">
+GET /%TESTNUMBER HTTP/1.1
+Host: %HOSTIP:%HTTPPORT
+User-Agent: curl/%VERSION
+Accept: */*
+
+</protocol>
+<file name="%LOGDIR/%TESTNUMBER" mode="text">
+-foo-
+</file>
+<stdout>
+</stdout>
+</verify>
+</testcase>
